_comment: P3 grandmother layer — summary.plain MONTHLY 'standing' read: 5 bands × 3 rotating variants (ISO-week % 3) × 4 locales. Transition-agnostic — it describes the current month's state + why, not the change; the week-over-week change lives in the separate weekly-openers.json lead-in (prepended by generate.mjs), and the monthly numbers live in the detailed memo. Self-contained so it also reads well with no weekly opener (synthetic-seed / no prior). One slot: {watching}. Warm, filler-cut voice; three nevers (no selling/promising/advising). CLO GO (founder 2026-07-11); native-reviewed per locale.
